post_capture_changes: Usage pruning before writing (BazelLockFileModule.java:226-249, :270-280): moduleExtensions/facts/factsVersions filtered to extension IDs of the current usage table (repository_catalog usage_extension_ids / isolated prefixes); only non-empty facts and non-zero factsVersions kept; no write when the usage table cannot be built (:95-100). Default registry https://bcr.bazel.build/ (BazelRepositoryModule.java:133) for query/build/mod graph without --registry; explicit --registry replaces it; mod graph still requires explicit --lockfile_mode=off (new message names the default). Eager resolution now also applies with the default remote registry in non-off modes.

Registry spelling as given (IndexRegistry.getUrl) in "Error accessing registry"/"source.json not found" messages; MissingChecksumException for MODULE.bazel reported unwrapped (ModuleFileFunction.java:841-843).

Tests that relied on no registry now pass explicit file:// registries (tests/module_cli.rs, tests/repositories.rs, tests/root_module_validation.rs helpers; tests/builtin_modules.rs, tests/repository_download_policy.rs, tests/module_cli.rs git test); module_cli unit tests updated + default-registry unit test. strace -e connect audit of the full cargo test: no connection to bcr.bazel.build; the only remaining non-loopback connections are the pre-existing GitHub archive download of tests/builtin_modules.rs (@arch query, explicit file:// builtin registry), present before this change.
scripts/validate.py, validate_build_settings.py, validate_builtin_modules.py native commands pass --lockfile_mode=off explicitly (others already did); 5 python unit tests updated.

Docs: REGISTRY_LOCKFILE.md (default registry and offline behaviour, pruning, version 28 written without the extension entries Bazel would regenerate, mod graph off-only, fast warm probes with --native-lockfile=<private path>, not-found wording), REMOTE_REPOSITORIES.md, REPOSITORY_VALIDATION.md, CUSTOM_RULE_VALIDATION.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, capabilities.json, --help.

The paired lockfile capture (run 2 above) was NOT rerun after these changes; native_sha256 above is the run-2 binary. Historical receipts quoting "registries []" (toolchains, cc_features) are unchanged evidence of their capture time.

default_registry_capture.method: no --registry for either engine; every run traced with strace -f -e trace=connect; external_connects counts non-loopback AF_INET/AF_INET6 connects (0 = offline). Network blocking (unshare) is unavailable here, so offline steps are chosen to fail before any request: error mode without lockfile, update mode with a lockfile recording the module as "not found".
